tools.description: Answers a Zwischenfrage about the current result of a Workflow run. The answer is grounded on the run and saved under the run. The run does not advance.
tools.name: ask_about_workflow_result

annotations.title: Ask a tax or legal question

tools.description: Answers a German tax or legal question with citations from the licensed Taxy knowledge base. Without chat_id the call starts a new conversation. With the chat_id from a previous answer it continues that conversation. file_ids grounds the answer on documents uploaded with upload_document.

external_user_id.description: Optional label for the caller's own end user (service keys only).

tools.name: ask_legal_question

annotations.title: Assess the extended trade tax deduction

tools.description: Assesses whether a planned property sale keeps a company's erweiterte Gewerbesteuer-Kuerzung (Sec. 9 No. 1 Sentence 2 GewStG) intact. It works through the Drei-Objekt-Grenze / gewerblicher Grundstueckshandel checklist, grounded in German tax commentary and case law. It accepts either structured case data (`case`) or a standardized PDF (`pdf_base64`), not both. Returns a per-condition checklist, an overall assessment, any open follow-up questions, and the sources it cited.
tools.name: assess_trade_tax_relief

tools.description: Creates a project for the caller. A project groups chats. The server adds the optional instruction to the system prompt of every chat in this project.
tools.name: create_project

tools.description: Deletes one of the caller's own chats, with its messages and citations. The deletion is permanent.
tools.name: delete_chat

tools.description: Deletes one of the caller's own projects. The chats in it are kept and become unfiled. The deletion is permanent.
tools.name: delete_project

tools.description: Returns the caller's Beratungsanlässe. The Workspace generates these advisory topics from the caller's own activity. The rows are the same rows the web app shows on Home. A row can carry a next_step that names the tool call for its action. With refresh true, the feed is regenerated before the read. A refresh spends the advisory_feed quota.

status.description: Filters the rows by status. Without it, the result is the default view of the web app.

language.description: de or nl. The language a refresh writes new rows in. It does not filter the rows. Without it, the caller's stored Workspace language applies.

refresh.description: true regenerates the feed before the read. A refresh spends the advisory_feed quota.

tools.name: get_advisory_feed

tools.description: Returns one of the caller's own chats in full, including its transcript and citations.
tools.name: get_chat

tools.description: Returns the whole document that one source chunk belongs to: its sibling chunks stitched in document order, up to a character budget. offset is a character position in the stitched text. A result carries next_offset, the offset where the next part starts. next_offset is null at the end of the document.
tools.name: get_document

tools.description: Returns the caller's standing chat instructions. The server adds this text to the system prompt of every chat.
tools.name: get_personal_instructions

tools.description: Returns one of the caller's Tabellenblick reviews as a grid of documents by criteria. cursor selects the next page of documents. A review that is still running returns its current state.
tools.name: get_sheet

tools.description: Returns one cited source chunk by its id: its full text, reference and deeplink, when the caller is licensed for it.
tools.name: get_source

tools.description: Returns one of the user's Workflow runs: its status, the latest output of every step, its citations and its Zwischenfragen. This works for an active run and for a finished run.
tools.name: get_workflow_run

tools.description: Lists the caller's entitled knowledge-base collections and, for each, the licensed publications with their titles where resolvable.
tools.name: list_available_publications

tools.description: Lists the caller's own chats, most recently active first.
tools.name: list_chats

tools.description: Lists the caller's own projects. A project groups chats and can hold a standing instruction.
tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: Lists the caller's own Tabellenblick reviews, newest first. cursor selects the next page of older reviews.
tools.name: list_sheets

tools.description: Lists the Tabellenblick templates (Vorlagen) the caller can use. Each row names the template and the criteria it checks as column headers. search filters by name or description.
tools.name: list_tabular_templates

tools.description: Lists the user's own Workflow runs, newest first. status filters by active, done or cancelled. limit bounds the list: default 20, at most 100.
tools.name: list_workflow_runs

tools.description: Lists the Workflows the user can run. search filters by name or description. area filters by category. The id of a row is the workflow_id that run_workflow accepts.
tools.name: list_workflows

tools.description: Health/entitlement probe — proves the auth, registry and metering pipeline end to end.
tools.name: ping

tools.description: Reviews uploaded documents against a Tabellenblick template (Vorlage). Accepts a template_id from list_tabular_templates and file_ids from upload_document. The server creates the review, runs it and returns the grid of documents by criteria. One call uses one Tabellenblick Vorgang.
tools.name: review_documents

annotations.title: Approve or redo a workflow step

tools.description: Answers the review gate of a Workflow run. approve true accepts the current step and runs the next one. approve false with feedback runs the current step again. edited_output replaces the output text of the current step. file_ids from upload_document attach documents to the next step.
tools.name: review_workflow_step

tools.description: Starts a Workflow on the user's case text and runs its first step. Accepts a workflow_id from list_workflows and the case text as input_text. file_ids from upload_document ground the run on documents. Returns the run with a run_id. The run stops at a review gate after each step.
tools.name: run_workflow

tools.description: Searches the caller's entitled German tax/legal knowledge base, and the caller's own uploaded documents. Returns full source chunks, not a generated answer. Each result carries the full chunk text, a reference, a deeplink, and a relevance score. A query that names a ruling by its Aktenzeichen or its ECLI returns that decision itself as the first result. An empty result means one thing only: the source is not in the publications this caller is licensed for. It is not evidence that the source does not exist, or that a citation is invented.
tools.name: search_legal_sources

tools.description: Records the rating a person gave for one assistant message: up or down. The rating is the person's own verdict on the answer. It is stored with the same evaluation data as the thumbs rating in the Workspace web app.
tools.name: set_message_feedback

tools.description: Replaces the caller's standing chat instructions. The server adds this text to the system prompt of every future chat. This includes the chats the person starts in the Workspace web app. An empty string clears the instructions.
tools.name: set_personal_instructions

tools.description: Changes one of the caller's own chats. title renames it. folder_id moves it into a project, and folder_id null removes it from its project. archived archives it. A field left out stays unchanged.
tools.name: update_chat

tools.description: Uploads a document into the caller's Workspace. Accepted file types: .docx, .pdf, .pptx, .txt. The document is parsed and indexed before the call returns. Returns a file_id that ask_legal_question, run_workflow and review_documents accept in file_ids.

mime_type.description: Optional and advisory. The server reads the type from the filename extension and ignores this value.

tools.name: upload_document

tools.description: Returns what this server is, the account the caller is signed in as, the tools the caller can call, and which of them count against the monthly allowance.
tools.name: whoami
